restoration_note: Teaching enumerates the seven works of the Living Spirit as he forms the cosmos (the natural mind in formation): (1) raising First Man as a pearl from the sea, (2) spreading the Crucified-Clothed One in every body, (3) crucifying the substances of death, (4) establishing the ships of light, (5) sending Five Sons to bear the Zone and stationing three Living Words against deceit-places, (6) sending powers/angels to guard the Zone's circuit, (7) the Third Ambassador's manifestation in the glorious image at the consummation. Editor proposals for letter-level completions and standing formulae (Pearl-from-Sea, Ambassador-manifests-forth, Aeons-of-Light, Panaretos) are confirmed. Ordinals at section starts (ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ, ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍϥⲧⲁⲩ) restored from the explicit pattern. Several short lacunae in the closing tableau (the engagement of the whole structure, the drawing inward, the building "there" in the new aeon) remain too damaged for confident reconstruction and are marked unrestorable.
